article.title: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević
article.description: Serbian historian, ethnographer, journalist and writer
article.extract: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević was a Serbian historian, ethnographer, journalist and writer.

turns.guesser:
So far I'm reading this as a bearded man who was a writer of ancient/military history, and also a farmer and folk or banjo musician. The 📍 line is a place, maybe a wordplay. One idea is Ballarat (🎾 ball + 🥇 gold rush), but I'm not sure about ⚡🔌.

Questions:
1. Is ⚡🔌 part of the place name (like Volt, Power, Edison or Watt), or the person's job (electrician or engineer)?
2. Is 🎾🥇 something that sounds like the place name? Show the country with a flag, please.
3. Which matters most: writer, historian, farmer or musician? Use 🥇 on the main one.

Got it. The place is home to a famous electrical scientist (Tesla?) and a tennis champion (Djokovic or Ivanišević?). The person is mainly an archaeologist or military historian (🏺⚔️), then a folklorist or ethnographer studying folk music and dance, then a writer or recorder of oral tradition.

Questions:
1. Is the place Serbia (Tesla + Djokovic) or Croatia (Tesla + Ivanišević)? Reply 🇷🇸 or 🇭🇷 if you can't use the flag. Otherwise 1️⃣ = Serbia, 2️⃣ = Croatia.
2. What century? Use 🕰️ plus a number.
3. Is 🏺 archaeology (digging up artifacts), or is ⚔️ history of wars?

Speculative guess:
GUESS: Ćiro Truhelka

Not Croatia, so probably Serbia. He was a war historian and ethnographer, and died in an air raid. The name is Jovan (✝️💦🏞️ = John the Baptist) + Hadži (pilgrim to Mecca) + Vasil (basil 🍃🍕) + -ević (son).

GUESS: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević
